introduction: Texas Child Care Services scholarships use Parent Central and local Workforce Solutions review. Joining a waiting list is the first stage, not approval for funded care.
description: Texas Child Care Services scholarships use Parent Central and local Workforce Solutions review. Joining a waiting list is the first stage, not approval for funded care.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on child age, family finances, Texas residence and a qualifying work, job-search, education or training situation. Disability-related age rules can differ.
sections.get: Help with approved child-care costs; a parent share may apply.
sections.docs:
• Household and child information.
  • Income and work or education records.
  • Provider information requested by the caseworker.
sections.apply:
1. Create Parent Central access

    Use the scholarship application links.

  2. Complete the screener

    Submit the Eligibility Screener and Waitlist application.

  3. Respond to local review

    When invited, complete the Standard Application and provider-selection steps.
sections.after: Ask the local Workforce Solutions office about waitlist status. Use KinderConnect for requested case records and communications.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current scholarship eligibility and application sequence. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is the screener the full application?
No. The state describes a later Standard Application after local review.
Can I choose any unregulated sitter?
Provider requirements apply; review eligible provider types before choosing care.
The local Workforce Solutions office handles status questions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
